text:
You were falling into me.

Echo of your weight, my life

was a song rushing

into eternity.


Immersed in my silence,

you are the sky that holds up a stream,

that raises a tree.

In which a morning star cuts its voice

of eternity.

translation.title: You Were Falling into Me...
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the falling beloved as weight, song, sky, stream, and star.
